meta.title: Add unified performance message support to FIO cases
meta.body_summary: Add unified performance messaging to FIO tool, enabling standardized reporting of IOPS and latency metrics alongside existing disk performance messages.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added unified perf messaging for FIO; merged after multiple iterations on design integration and metric naming per LiliDeng's feedback.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Small change across two files, mostly in lisa/tools/fio.py. As a feature addition to an existing performance tool, the 156-line change merged after several design and naming iterations, which fits a moderate collaboration process.

review_details.concern_detail: LiliDeng requested moving unified messaging logic into the existing create_performance_messages method instead of a separate method, and later required including DiskSetup, iodepth, numjob in metric names and reverting a placement change.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable standardized performance metrics reporting for FIO alongside existing disk performance messages.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a feature to an existing performance tool required iterative guidance on project conventions for method integration and metric naming; no performance evaluation barrier.

detection_detail.code_reading: LiliDeng reviewed the code, requested integration into existing method, and specified additional fields for metric names (DiskSetup, iodepth, numjob).
detection_detail.ci_auto: Flake8 CI failed on trailing whitespace, leading to a fix commit.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: LiliDeng manually tested and posted a results screenshot; squirrelsc confirmed LGTM after seeing results.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Agent added commits to address all review comments: design change, field additions, ordering revert, and CI flake8 fix.

core_change_summary.description: In lisa/tools/fio.py, integrated unified performance message generation into create_performance_messages by constructing metric names with disk_setup_type, iodepth, numjob, block_size, core_count, disk_count, and sending IOPS and latency metrics with appropriate relativity.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: common.py had temporary additions for separate method call but was reverted to original; no final change.
